answer: The copper counter is kept in nebula and reef publishes each reset. A bond is refunded only after 43 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. An adversary therefore has to keep every alias continuously active for 43 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 3580 identities would post 4367 proofs and burn roughly 69 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
